coordinate_system: Positions are 1-based residue numbers in each species' Ensembl release 116 canonical protein (protein_id given). Alignment columns are 1-based. Variant anchors: zebrafish positions refer to the zebrafish protein; lat4a F326L refers to the medaka protein as numbered by Daane 2021. Projected flying-fish rows are placed on medaka residues; residues inserted relative to medaka are dropped and uncovered positions are gaps, so those rows have no own-protein numbering.

danio_rerio.role: reference teleost (Cypriniformes); the engineered fish is a zebrafish

oryzias_latipes.role: Beloniformes, the flying fish order; closest annotated proxy for flying fish

drosophila_melanogaster.role: flying insect; insect wings are not homologous to vertebrate limbs

hirundichthys_speculiger.role: flying fish (Exocoetidae): annotated protein from Xu et al. 2021 (Front Genet 12:695700), orthology by reciprocal best blastp hit to zebrafish
hirundichthys_speculiger.assembly: GCA_018398805.1 (same assembly as the figshare annotation)
hirundichthys_speculiger.caveat: H. speculiger is not one of the species Daane 2021 measured for fin length (Cheilopogon, Exocoetus, Hirundichthys rondeleti): cross-species within the family. Annotation is automated (BLAST/InterPro hits), not curated.
